tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind every template.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, verdict box, header bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Table header rows, screenshot frames, search field, alternating bands.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on paper, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, captions, table labels on paper, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Links, primary buttons, active nav, focus ring. Text on paper and surface.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panels: verdict box header, highlighted table column, category tiles. Brand or ink text on it.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Signature highlight: Editor's choice, winner marks, rank #1. Small areas only, always with on-lime text.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text on lime.

tokens.name: logo-ground
tokens.usage: Tile behind the contour mark, the same in both themes so the lime contours keep their contrast.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: Outbound affiliate buttons (Try / Visit / Get deal) only. One per block.

tokens.name: on-cta
tokens.usage: Text on a cta fill.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Rating stars. Always next to the numeric score.

tokens.name: pro
tokens.usage: Pros icons and the 'yes' mark in comparison tables; always paired with a + or check glyph.

tokens.name: con
tokens.usage: Cons icons and the 'no' mark in comparison tables; always paired with a minus or cross glyph.

tokens.name: score-high
tokens.usage: Score badge fill for 8.0 and above.

tokens.name: score-mid
tokens.usage: Score badge fill for 6.0 to 7.9.

tokens.name: score-low
tokens.usage: Score badge fill below 6.0.

tokens.name: on-score
tokens.usage: Numerals on any score-* fill.
